case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked for a clear basis on volume and planning, and our options give you exactly that: a binding volume over a contract term that runs well beyond your offer, so your committee can plan with certainty.

Your cost points on copper and labour are taken seriously. This is how we see the price:

Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On our own order history with you:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the binding volume and the longer term in every option, and the price in Option A is set against the price history above.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this may need your pricing committee, here is a paragraph it can approve as it stands: Option A gives Selvbrunn Drive Systems a binding annual volume over a fixed contract term, with full planning certainty for the frequency converter and a clearly defined price and payment term. We ask you to take Option A to the committee. If it needs anything further from us for the approval, we will provide it.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the price history and volume change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your verified order history and volume forecast, which allows us to make an adjustment to our initial proposal. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Our proposal stands at a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

While a 90-day payment term is not feasible for us, we can accommodate the 24-month contract duration with a 45-day payment term as outlined in your Option C. Based on this structure, we can offer a revised unit price of €429.43. 

Alternatively, we can offer a package with a price of €429.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €429.43 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.
